name: Tricky Handstand
body:
School transmutation; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 move action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You move half your speed. You are not subject to attacks of opportunity for this move.
